notes: Tickets can now have file attachments, both when creating and replying. Nuemeta Actions moved to a per-track button, plus a real Spotify Profile editor in Moderation. Fixed drafts piling up as separate copies, a support-email list-formatting bug, and "Past cases" always showing 0. Hardened the local database against corruption from a force-quit. Added a "Create tickets from new mail" setting, off by default, to prevent duplicate tickets when more than one installation is open at once.

windows_notes: Fixed bulleted and numbered lists showing correctly while drafting a reply but losing their bullets/numbers in Preview. Added search to the canned responses picker - type to filter by name or content instead of scrolling the full list. Fixed Claude's drafted replies greeting the customer by their raw email address instead of their actual artist name.
